name: GLM-4.7-Flash-24B-A3B-KREAP-Code
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from zai-org/GLM-4.7-Flash (config.json max_position_embeddings 202752). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A derivative of zai-org/GLM-4.7-Flash, not a new base model: same config.json, routed expert count REDUCED 64 -> 48 per layer by one-shot structural pruning, so num_experts is 48 here, not the base's 64. 24.274B total vs base 31.22B (22.25% fewer parameters), 45.23 GiB vs the base checkpoint; BF16/F32 safetensors, top-4 routing unchanged, no fine-tuning. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2026-07-27. CAVEATS: KIND: one-shot REAP-style MoE expert pruning (routed experts 64->48 per layer, top-4 routing unchanged), 24.274B vs base 31.22B, no fine-tuning. This is the authors' own comparison control, published as a baseline rather than a deployment model: it wins only LiveCodeBench v6 (25.1 vs 22.9) and GSM8K (86.7 vs 86.3) and loses badly on most other rows - Korean MC macro 53.5 vs 68.8, MMLU-en 59.6 vs 69.7, HumanEval+ 80.5 vs 81.1, coding 3-bench macro 57.7 vs 58.3. Recorded because the card prints both columns and the two wins are real, but it is not a better model overall.
